Email:mockmentorofficial@gmail.com Telegram: Mockmentor Website: www.mockmentor.in List of Reports Important for RBI Grade B Phase-2 1 This document contains the list of the reports that is important from RBI Grade B Phase-2 perspective. JANUARY- 1. World Employment and Social Outlook (WESA) 2025 (ILO)- Top Priority 2. Global Investment Trends Monitor 2024 (UNCTAD)- Medium Priority 3. Global Risks Report (WEF)- Top Priority 4. Report on Trend and Progress of Banking in India 2023-24 (RBI)- Top Priority 5. Annual Report of Ombudsman Scheme (RBI)- Top Priority FEBRUARY- 1. Asia and Pacific SDG Progress Report 2025 (UNESCAP)- Low Priority MARCH- No Significant Reports APRIL- 1. Panchayat Advancement Index (MoPR) - Low Priority 2. Fiscal Health Index (NITI Aayog)- Medium Priority 3. State of Social Protection: 2 Billion Person Challenge (World Bank)- Top Priority 4. Poverty and Equity Brief (World Bank)- Top Priority 5. Financial Sector Assessment Program (IMF and World Bank)- Top Priority 6. Global Financial Stability Report (IMF) - Top Priority 7. World Economic Outlook (IMF) - Top Priority MAY- 1. Human Development Report (UNDP)- Top Priority 2. Enhancing MSME competitiveness in India (NITI Aayog)- Low Priority JUNE- 1. RBI Annual Report 2024-25- Top Priority 2. RBI Financial Stability Report- Top Priority 3. Global Gender Gap Report (WEF)- Top Priority 4. Global Economic Prospects (World Bank) - Top Priority 5. Sustainable Development Report 2025 (UNSDSN)- Top Priority JULY- 1. Global Findex Report (World Bank)- Top Priority

# Page 2^page=2
Email:mockmentorofficial@gmail.com Telegram: Mockmentor Website: www.mockmentor.in List of Reports Important for RBI Grade B Phase-2 2 AUGUST- 1. The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) 2025 (FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO)- Medium Priority 2. Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2023-2024 (MoSPI)- Medium Priority 3. FREE-AI Committee Report (RBI)-Top Priority SEPTEMBER- 1. Sample Registration System (SRS) Bulletin 2023 (RGI&CCI)- Medium Priority 2. World Trade Report 2025 (WTO)- Medium Priority 3. Children in India 2025 (MoSPI)- Medium Priority OCTOBER- 1. Payment Systems Report, June 2025 (RBI)- Top Priority 2. Global Forest Resource Assessment Report (FAO)- Medium Priority 3. The State of Social Justice 2025: A work in progress (ILO)- Top Priority 4. India’s Services Sector (NITI Aayog)- Medium Priority 5. South Asia Update October 2025: Jobs, AI, and Trade (World Bank)- Medium Priority 6. World Economic Outlook: Global Economy in Flux, Prospects Remain Dim (IMF)- Top Priority In addition to these reports, the Union Budget and Economic Survey have to be invariably done. Note- Only these reports have to be done for RBI Phase-2. One more updated version of this list will be shared with you to cover the important list of reports for November 2025 Be Curious, Be Conscious, Be Better
